description: Installs the complete set of dotnet new project templates for Nano-based applications in one package - minimal API, Web, and Console applications, an internal service-to-service API pre-wired with Azure Managed Identity federated to Kubernetes Workload Identity, and a public-facing API - all pre-wired with Docker/Kubernetes deployment and CI/CD. More templates are added to this same package over time.
title: Nano Core Visual Studio Templates
